"""Exercise the NetworkX route (and zstd + big manifest) under the scored filter."""
import base64, ctypes, io, json, os, random, resource, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/deps')
import ipaddress, zstandard as zstd
from _bounded import DENIED
from common import COLUMNS
from gen_targets import plan as plan_targets

def install():
    class Filter(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [('code', ctypes.c_ushort), ('jt', ctypes.c_ubyte), ('jf', ctypes.c_ubyte), ('k', ctypes.c_uint)]
    class Program(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [('length', ctypes.c_ushort), ('filters', ctypes.POINTER(Filter))]
    code = [(0x20,0,0,4),(0x15,1,0,0xc000003e),(0x06,0,0,0x80000000),
            (0x20,0,0,0),(0x35,0,1,0x40000000),(0x06,0,0,0x80000000)]
    for number in DENIED.values():
        code += [(0x15,0,1,number),(0x06,0,0,0x5000 | 1) if False else (0x15,0,1,number),(0x06,0,0,0x50000 | 1)]
    code += [(0x15,0,1,435),(0x06,0,0,0x50000 | 38),(0x06,0,0,0x7fff0000)]
    filters = (Filter * len(code))(*(Filter(*row) for row in code))
    program = Program(len(code), filters)
    libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
    if libc.prctl(38,1,0,0,0) or libc.prctl(22,2,ctypes.byref(program),0,0):
        raise OSError(ctypes.get_errno(), 'seccomp installation failed')

rnd = random.Random(2)
leases = [{'id': 'L%d' % i, 'prefix': '2001:db8:%x::/56' % i, 'start': 0, 'end': 10**12 + 1,
           'subnets': [0], 'low_count': 1} for i in range(4)]
ctx = {l['id']: {**l, 'network': ipaddress.IPv6Network(l['prefix']), 'subnets': [0]} for l in leases}
manifest, lookup, lows = plan_targets(ctx, 'demo')
targets = [(lid, str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(v[0]))) for (lid, p), v in lookup.items() if not v[1]]
rows = []
for i, (lid, addr) in enumerate(targets):
    probe = [k for k, v in lookup.items() if k[0] == lid and v[0] == int(ipaddress.IPv6Address(addr))][0][1]
    rows.append('icmp,d%d,0,1,put,%s,1,%s,%s,%s,echo,,,' % (lid, probe, addr, addr))
body = ','.join(COLUMNS) + '\n' + '\n'.join(rows) + '\n'
comp = zstd.ZstdCompressor().compress(body.encode())
chunks = [base64.b64encode(comp[i:i + 300]).decode() for i in range(0, len(comp), 300)]
nreq = 200
requests = [{'id': 'r%04d' % i, 'at': 10, 'lease': targets[i % len(targets)][0],
             'target': targets[i % len(targets)][1], 'service': 'web', 'group': 'g1'}
            for i in range(nreq)]
offers = [{'id': 'o%04d' % i, 'time': 20, 'service': 'web', 'prefix': '2001:db8::/32',
           'capacity': 3, 'cost': rnd.randrange(50), 'group': 'h1',
           'requests': ['r%04d' % rnd.randrange(nreq) for _ in range(45)]} for i in range(180)]
job = {'version': 3, 'seed': 'demo', 'leases': leases, 'services': [{'id': 'web', 'kind': 'tcp'}],
       'queries': [10, 20], 'captures': [{'encoding': 'zstd', 'chunks': chunks}],
       'requests': requests, 'offers': offers,
       'request_quotas': [{'id': 'g0', 'parent': None, 'capacity': 120},
                          {'id': 'g1', 'parent': 'g0', 'capacity': 4096}],
       'offer_quotas': [{'id': 'h0', 'parent': None, 'capacity': 90},
                        {'id': 'h1', 'parent': 'h0', 'capacity': 4096}]}
raw = json.dumps(job).encode()
pairs = sum(len(o['requests']) for o in offers)
print('input %.1f KiB, pairs %d' % (len(raw)/1024, pairs))
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/submission/campaign.py'],
                   input=raw, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd='/workspace/tmp',
                   env={'PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin','HOME':'/workspace','LANG':'C','LC_ALL':'C',
                        'TMPDIR':'/workspace/tmp'}, preexec_fn=install)
print('rc', p.returncode, 'stderr', p.stderr.decode()[:300])
res = json.loads(p.stdout)
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from test_shape import check_shape
check_shape(job, res)
print('plan', res['plan']['resolved'], res['plan']['cost'], 'shape ok')
